name: com.danielnoam.helpfuleditor
description:
Editor quality-of-life for the Hierarchy, Inspector, Project and Game View windows: zebra striping and tree guides, component strips, component isolation and drag reordering, per-component header buttons, symlinked folder badges, and Game View rulers with guides.

Editor-only and self-contained. Settings live in ProjectSettings/HelpfulEditor/ and are tracked by source control.
